title: Anthropic Just Launched Claude Opus 4.8
description:
Anthropic has released Claude Opus 4.8, and it comes with two upgrades that meaningfully change how the model performs in real working conditions. The first is a significant improvement in self-correction. Opus 4.8 is four times less likely to overlook flaws in its own code compared to its predecessor, Opus 4.7, meaning it actively reviews what it has produced and catches mistakes before they become a problem downstream. That alone is a substantial leap for anyone using Claude in development or engineering workflows. The second upgrade is dynamic task handling. Claude can now break down large, complex tasks and distribute them across multiple parallel subagents, each working on a different piece of the same job at the same time. Instead of processing everything sequentially, the model handles it simultaneously, which means faster completion, fewer bottlenecks, and a much more capable system for tackling the kind of multi-layered work that previously required significant human oversight. Together, these two upgrades push Opus 4.8 meaningfully ahead of where the previous version stood. It is available right now on the Anthropic API.

#Anthropic #ClaudeOpus #AINews
